### Borea v0.6.21

A patch release for `borea://modlist` links. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### New

- When a multiplayer server sends its modlist link again after its mods changed, Borea offers to update the instance that the earlier link made, or to create a new one. The dialog shows which mods are added, changed, removed or kept before anything happens.
- An update removes only mods that came from the link. Mods you added yourself stay, and so does their place in the load order.

#### For mod and server authors

- Add a fixed `id` to the link, for example `&id=my-server`, so that Borea can find the instance again. A link without an `id` still creates a new instance every time.

#### Good to know

- An instance made from such a link records its list `id`. If an older Borea saves that instance, it forgets the `id`, and the next link then creates a new instance.

Full changelog: [v0.6.20...v0.6.21](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.20...v0.6.21)
